title: Site barrel velocity inputs and current WPM/WME candidate bindings

scope.selectionCoverage: Exact existing site attachment map by weapon/slot/attachment. Leaf coverage is per shared BARRELS entry; exact site weapon applicability is retained per row.

velMult.candidateSourceField: WME MuzzleVelocity Class_3e93759b/Field_6a5c4efd; descriptor-derived offset and raw bytes agree with decoded source values
velMult.remaining: Field meaning is inferred from WME route and source/site numeric match; native consumption not proven.

velTierMod.derivation: The five captured WME MuzzleVelocity factors 0.8/1.25 at Class_3e93759b/Field_6a5c4efd map to site velTierMod -1/+1 through the Analyzer's explicit formula multiplier=0.8^(-velTierMod). The factor values have descriptor-derived raw-byte matches. This closes the site encoding as a derived representation of the source candidate factor, not as an independent native integer field.
velTierMod.neutralRows: Site velTierMod=0 remains a site neutral/default where the selected WPM has no imported MuzzleVelocity WME; no native modifier is claimed.

limits: XML selector mapping and WPM capture imports establish configured source chain, not runtime selector priority/application.
Descriptor-derived WME field raw offsets prove exact stored values, not the semantic field label.
The factor identity is inferred from the WME route and exact source/site factor match; the source value and the site's derived tier encoding do not prove runtime effect selection.
KSG is outside site roots; no KSG-to-ks18k join is used.
